name: social-media-downloader
description: Personal downloader for public X/Instagram/Facebook videos
author: me

scripts.setup:backend: python -m venv backend/.venv && backend\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.build:backend: backend\.venv\Scripts\python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --onedir --name backend --distpath backend/dist --specpath backend/build --workpath backend/build --collect-all yt_dlp --collect-all imageio_ffmpeg backend/main.py
scripts.build:win: pnpm build:backend && pnpm build:web && electron-builder --win dir && node_modules\rcedit\bin\rcedit-x64.exe dist\win-unpacked\SocialMediaDownloader.exe --set-icon build\icon.ico && node -e "const f='dist/win-unpacked/SocialMediaDownloader.exe';require('fs').utimesSync(f,new Date(),new Date())"
